prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished illustrated storyboard contact sheet for a Japanese Vocaloid music video inspired by the game Reversi Destiny ～黒白の運命～. EXACTLY nine distinct rectangular illustrations in a perfectly regular 3 columns x 3 rows grid. Overall landscape 16:9 canvas, ideally 3840x2160, each panel landscape 16:9. Thin straight uniform dark dividers, no inset panels, no merged panels. All nine panels fully painted, high detail, cinematic compositions, safe margins for cropping. No text, lyrics, lettering, logos, watermarks, numbers, speech balloons or music notation. Original game's dark painterly fantasy aesthetic blended with expressive polished anime MV lighting, tactile hand painted textures, strong silhouettes and beautiful contrast. Reversi pieces are smooth round black and white discs, NEVER chess pieces. Story is grief, family regret, and choices with no single correct answer. No triumphant resurrection or uncomplicated happy ending. Human character design is not established in canon: depict Kuroya the living young Japanese male protagonist with understated short dark hair and plain dark contemporary clothing, mainly rear views, side silhouette, closeups of hands, face obscured; younger sister Mashiro in modest light hospital clothes, dark straight hair only as a restrained provisional depiction, mostly rear/side views. Keep these provisional humans visually consistent, no elaborate new costumes, no Vocaloid mascot character. Use the supplied three images as ORIGINAL CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCES, not as panels to paste: Image 1 Observer = tall black smoky ragged humanoid cloak, spiky silhouette/head, tiny white luminous observation core instead of a human face, faint board grid on robe, orbiting round reversi discs, gray/silver cosmic mist. Image 2 Executor = pointed black hood, faceless black void with tiny orange red glow, shredded black layered cloak, fiery diagonal blade and amber embers. Image 3 Theory Incarnation = black void spiky head, broad layered pointed shoulder armor, large dark feathered wing shapes, long black and silver board-grid robes, open hands. Preserve their specific silhouettes and details; do not turn them into handsome human mages or generic robots. VARIANT 1: 兄妹の記憶. A melancholic intimate piano/Vocaloid ballad visual sequence, warm ivory memories versus desaturated blue present. Read left to right row by row. 1) Macro of a young man's hand hovering over a black reversi disc, hospital curtain sunshine, soft focus white discs. 2) Warm hospital room wide shot of brother sitting beside younger sister, friendly playful body language as she makes a clever reversi move; mostly backs and profiles. 3) Sister seen from behind gazing through hospital window at a distant ordinary school life, quiet longing. 4) Brother alone at a world reversi final under harsh stage spotlights, opponent only anonymous distant silhouette, enormous negative space and tiny board, no audience faces or text. 5) Extreme closeup tense fingertips releasing a black disc, image of pale hospital curtains reflected in glossy disc, symbolic hesitation. 6) Empty hospital bed and unoccupied visitor chair at dusk, neatly arranged sheets, unfinished reversi game in foreground, no body. 7) Four years later, young man rear silhouette in a dim ordinary room facing a closed dusty reversi board, rain on window, exhaustion and grief, no self-harm objects. 8) Original Observer emerges from swirling silver cosmic mist in the room, extending a clawlike hand toward a faint white distant light; Kuroya turns toward it. 9) Wide rear view of Kuroya and original Observer at the threshold of a cosmic black and white checkerboard world, a tiny white disc light in the distance; tentative movement into uncertainty. These are narrative emotional keyframes, not a literal concert or singing scene.
